messages.subject: Instane Idle Timeout
parts: Is there a way to keep the instance running indefinitely by setting the instance idle timeout to -1 or 0? (I understand that this will incur a cost but under the paid standard and professional plan this should be possible).

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Instane Idle Timeout
parts:
http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#worker-settings

See Read Timeout.

But there has to be a connection. If there are no connections, the application will be shut down.
